active_node_gap.finding: Private BFT proof checks expanded keys/cipher graphs and executed cryptography synchronously in the parent, unlike native classified PVAC workers. A semaphore alone does not enforce native timeout/RSS.
active_node_gap.behavior: Public immutable byte images+metadata only in the parent; required scoped requests use the shared owned process service for decode, serialization, amount/range/claim/key-switch verification and balance arithmetic. Exact deterministic rejection bytes are separate from operational errors. Host scopes, cancellation, PVAC actor propagation and the shared pool are integrated by the native executor and runtime adapters. Standalone component APIs retain explicit no-Scope local behavior; production CLI uses isolated runtime.

active_node_gap.admission: The same owned runner uses independent native lanes: FHE actor1active; PVAC Compute_pool capacity1/2, Required128, Speculative6, burst4. Native BFT private proofs queue Required; Circle typed prepared proofs and synchronous OCTB use immediate Speculative; asynchronous OCTB uses FHE actor. Single speculative range jobs join the same proof channel with native40x50ms retry. No generic global active cap serializes the independent native lanes. Typed Circle parsing and invocation scopes are part of the executor/runtime integration.
